svg.text: Hinge: a piano hinge along the top edge, one leaf riveted to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: flap, the other screwed into the south wall's top batten.

svg.text: of centre, bodies screwed into the sill batten below the opening.
